name: Work Xchange
source: Work Xchange is a sexually explicit adventure game featuring feminization and playful submission. You will assume the role of a shy heterosexual man, who just arrived at a peculiar office for a job interview. However, you soon end up transformed into a pretty maiden, and compelled to work at a mysterious remote resort in order to prove your value.
translation: 《职场性转》是一部主打女性化改造与俏皮臣服调教的露骨成人冒险游戏。你将扮演一名腼腆的异性恋男子，刚刚来到一家古怪的公司参加求职面试；谁知转眼之间，你竟被改造成了一位娇俏可人的妙龄少女，并被迫前往一座偏远神秘的度假村打工，以此证明自己的价值。
